mainEntity.name: What should I do when my AI assistant gives me wrong or unusable work?

acceptedAnswer.text: When AI output is wrong, pause the workflow, identify the specific failure, correct the source or instruction, and rerun a small test before restoring automation. Run My AI Biz emphasizes refinement, source verification, approval checkpoints, and restrictions against invented claims. Context: Repeating the same prompt without diagnosing the failure usually produces the same problem. Key factors: - Determine whether the cause was missing context, bad source material, ambiguous instructions, or an integration error. - Keep a record of the failed example and corrected result. - Add a stop condition for similar cases. Practical guidance: Build an error checklist covering facts, tone, links, calculations, permissions, and customer impact. Review several new outputs before trusting the revised workflow again.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pause the workflow, identify whether the problem came from missing context, weak sources, unclear instructions, or an integration, then correct the cause and test a small sample. Record the failure and add a stop condition for similar cases.
